local_lesson_alignment.rationale: The lesson addresses responsible use of materials, minimising finishing waste, approved finish selection and safe waste handling. ENV addresses environmental impact; USE addresses justified material and equipment choices. This pairing is a local lesson alignment, not an assertion that NESA assigns these two outcomes exclusively to this content item.
